ThingDef.label: milking machine
ThingDef.description:
A milking machine. There are many things to attach to the body, so can't lie down and use it on one's own, and have to get help from others. This is the same when exit the milking machine. Also, when lying in the milking machine, have to feed by someone.

Not only the colonist, but also the prisoner and slaves are able to lie in this milk machine.

This can force milking not only pregnancy or after childbirth, but also even if can't milking yet.
